auditor: independent AI auditor (did not write the paper); a fresh one for every round

audits.summary: All paper numbers trace to logged runs. Recomputing the analysis script reproduces every derived statistic, and two re-executed runs (CE and band-ignore CE, flip_p0.3, seed 2) match the registry exactly. The code matches the described method and baselines with a shared budget and no test leakage beyond a disclosed budget choice, and negative and mixed results are reported plainly; remaining issues are minor overstatements in the ablation wording, a missing segmentation-specific prior-work citation and small layout problems.

findings.issue: States 'the gap to clean labels widens with data' as fact; the drop difference is 0.06, smaller than one seed std (0.11), with Welch p=0.25.
findings.fix: Describe it as a non-significant point estimate, consistent with the inconclusive H3 verdict.

findings.issue: 'The largest q is clearly worst' overstates 0.45+-0.15 vs 0.54+-0.11 / 0.59+-0.09 with three seeds (within one std).
'SCE is indistinguishable from CE' glosses over SCE being 0.08 lower under boundary noise and lower on clean labels (paired p=0.023).
findings.fix: Say SCE is not better than CE on any task and lower in mean on clean and boundary labels.

findings.issue: Calls Karimi et al. the 'closest prior work' without support; segmentation-specific studies of label quality vs quantity (e.g. Zlateski et al., CVPR 2018) are not cited.
findings.fix: Add the relevant segmentation label-noise/label-quality citations and soften the 'closest prior work' claim.

findings.issue: 'the damage is entirely a foreground-class confusion' contradicts the limitations section, which says this is not isolated by any run.
findings.fix: Change to 'is consistent with a foreground-class confusion'.

findings.issue: The two single-seed clean-label runs used to choose the 600-step/lr 1e-2 budget (scored on test) are not in the registry.
findings.fix: Log those runs or state explicitly that they were not logged.

findings.issue: Header URL runs past the page margin; Fig. 1 x-axis labels overlap ('boundary_p0.3flip_p0.3').
findings.fix: Break or shorten the URL and rotate or shorten the tick labels.
